_comment: ZENIT HYPERTUNE update manifest - repo root. App polls the raw URL once per day. sha256 = SHA256 of the setup exe; sig = Ed25519 signature over this manifest (signing.py). The app trusts a manifest only with a valid signature - without one it offers nothing, because url and sha256 come from the same unsigned file and would otherwise vouch for each other.
notes:
### The License button opens its door again

#### Fixed
- **The License button in the lower sidebar opens the license page again.** The click had stopped working in v8.6.26; this release restores it. Nothing else was changed.

#### Release
- The installer is built and the manifest is signed. Please verify the SHA-256 of the installer and the signature of the manifest against the release page before installing.
